title: anti-Byzantine attack federal learning method for protecting user data privacy
assignee: University of Electronic Science and Technology of China

pse.problem: Privacy inference and Byzantine attack threats in federated learning systems used for medical diagnosis
pse.solution_function: The system uses homomorphic encryption technology to encrypt gradients uploaded by computing parties for privacy protection. It also implements data analysis on gradient data to resist Byzantine attacks, filtering out abnormal nodes and updating the model with data from normal nodes.
pse.solution_structure: The system consists of local medical institutions (nodes) that hold sensitive data, a central server that aggregates gradients, and encryption technology for secure communication.
pse.solution_implementation: The local nodes perform local training using their data and encrypt the gradients using homomorphic encryption. The central server aggregates these encrypted gradients without decryption, performs data analysis to filter out abnormal nodes, and updates the model with normal nodes' data after decryption.
pse.effect: Improved security against privacy leakage and Byzantine attacks in federated learning systems for medical diagnosis, maintaining user data privacy while ensuring accurate training of deep learning models.
